text: Breizh Cola is the cola brand of Brasserie Lancelot, a French SAS (RCS Vannes B 950 471 177) belonging to the Breton agricultural cooperative Agrial: Agrial's Boissons branch lists Breizh Cola and Lancelot among its brands.
short: Breizh Cola is a Brasserie Lancelot brand within the Agrial cooperative.
